selection.selection_reason: Prespecified complete sequential Backend v0.19.0 correction cycle after frozen-source regression review: seeded 200-patient E1, 30 scripts x 5 E2, validation of those E2 outputs, three E3 configurations x 30 scripts, then mock and real E4. All six stages and three E3 children passed 30-patient/521-resource preflights. Existing model roles, prompts, temperatures, seeds and acceptance thresholds were not tuned. The new classification role uses the unchanged feasibility prompt and the configured report-extraction provider/model, with conservative handling. Superseded runs remain intact; this is not best-run selection.
selection.excluded_runs_policy: All runs remain inventoried; interrupted, superseded and historical formal runs are retained but not pooled into this frozen correction cohort.
selection.load_caveat: Both modes use Backend v0.19.0 and replay this selected E2. They differ in load level and patient pool. The unchanged mock chooses first-enum/minimum-index values: single-entry classification has no disease semantics and multiple entries trigger duplicate-index fallback. Mock and real are different workloads; replay/session failures and request-error rates are distinct, descriptive local observations, not national capacity.
